ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with less than 5% high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the distal tips and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark pigment across the majority of the fluke; fine-grained, high-contrast white speckling and mottling concentrated at the extreme distal tips (points) and sporadically along the trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and a depth of roughly 12% of the total fluke height from the top edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude variation of approximately 2-5 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex sweep from the proximal center toward the distal tips, transitioning to a sharp concave curve as they converge toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible, multi-colored (brown/tan/white) pixel clusters of complex geometry at the distal tips of both left and right lobes, indicative of dense barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive bio-fouling/barnacle growth on the outer distal tips creating irregular, jagged silhouettes that disrupt the natural lobe curve.
